test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the sentence that is free from spelling errors. **

options.text: One needs to abide by certain instructions in every society.
One needs to adide by certain instructions in every society.
One needs to abide by certain instructiones in every society.
One needs to abide by certain instructions in every socity.

solution:
The correct answer is** "One needs to abide by certain instructions in every society."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"abide,"** not **"adide" **or **"abidee."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"instructions,"** not **"instructiones."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"society,"** not **"society."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 1.

 ​**

**Correct sentence:* ****One needs to abide by certain instructions in every society.*
